speaker: Representative
phrases: What if a road could remember?
Not just a problem today, but how it changed—and what happened next.

speaker: Police
phrases: A fixed camera sees one patch.
An incident can happen just beyond it.

speaker: Representative
phrases: A bus sees the road as it moves.
In our vision, its camera turns an image into an observation: what, where, and when.

speaker: Police
phrases: After a hit-and-run, which way did that vehicle go?

phrases.text: Connect possible sightings by appearance, place and time—not assumed identity.
Rash-driving reports and missing-person candidates
also need evidence, not automatic conclusions.

speaker: Municipality
phrases: One photograph shows a pothole.
But is it getting worse?

phrases.text: Drishti links repeat observations into a history.
This demo condition index rises from eighteen to eighty-eight.
Seventy is a chart reference, not an automatic repair trigger.
Later repair and verification records show forty-two, then eight.

speaker: Citizen
phrases: The rain stops. But this stretch keeps flooding.

speaker: Representative
phrases: Repeated waterlogging observations reveal persistence at the same location.
These are recorded conditions—not predictions of tomorrow’s rain.

phrases.text: Faded crossings at Phoenix Mall.
Unmanaged school crossings.
Displaced dividers.
Missing or damaged signs.
Bent guardrails.
Debris blocking the road. Each needs its own condition history.

speaker: Police
phrases: An obstruction can make traffic pile up.

phrases.text: Is the count unusual? Compare the same observation window.
One hundred eighty-four divided by sixty is about three point one.
A later count of sixty gives one. That is new evidence of recovery.

speaker: Municipality
phrases: Now close one road for metro work. Where does its traffic go?

phrases.text: This eight-week demo scenario redistributes seventy percent: one hundred twenty-nine vehicles an hour.
Three connected roads share that load, weighted by their spare capacity.
More room means a larger share. Then compare the new flow with capacity.
Cathedral Road reaches about ninety-five percent. These are scenario estimates, not guaranteed forecasts.

speaker: Citizen
phrases: Old road notices and bus information are confusing.
Why does a closed road still look usable?

phrases.text: A government-approved restriction enters Drishti’s shared record.
A candidate route using that closed road becomes unavailable—not a longer ETA.
Compare the remaining options, including their recorded delays.

speaker: Police
phrases: For an urgent eligible case, which station is nearest?

speaker: Representative
phrases: Compare distances from the event to the stations.
The prototype chooses the nearest—not a guaranteed fastest responder.

speaker: Police
phrases: We spend less time searching
and more time responding.

speaker: Municipality
phrases: We stop waiting for problems
to become complaints.

speaker: Citizen
phrases: We see a city that actually reflects
what is happening around us.

speaker: Representative
phrases: That’s the difference between a reactive city
and a proactive one.
